description:
Write ADRs (matching docs/adr format with Date/Status/Source/bw cross-ref) for every deliberate deviation from the rules:
- complexity/nesting thresholds for a compiler codebase
- test fixtures exercising linted constructs (cond/dbg/IO.inspect)
- compile-time priv resolution via __DIR__ (PathExpandPriv suppression)
- any @dialyzer nowarn_function used
Each ADR: context, decision, consequences, and how to revisit. Reference the bw ticket.
title: ADRs for out-of-bounds decisions
